name: quartz
description: A gem for calling Go code from within your Ruby code

documents.title: Introducción
documents.text: quartz Quartz enables you to call Go code from within your Ruby code. This is accomplished by running a Go program as a child process of your Ruby application and using UNIX domain sockets for communication. With this gem, you can now write performance critical code in Go, and that code can be called from anywhere in a Ruby project. To see some real world examples where Go can aid a Ruby project, please see the examples/ directory.

documents.title: Defining exportable structs
documents.text: Quartz shares Go code by exporting methods on a struct to Ruby. Quartz requires that all arguments to exported struct methods be JSON serializable types. Additionally, the arguments to an exported method should be of the form (A, B) , where A and B are JSON serializable types. The method should also return an error.
